test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.

The make-up room was filled / with incadescent lights / which added to the misery / of those subjected to make-up.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"incadescent"** is incorrectly spelled and should be **"incandescent" **which means** emitting light as a result of being heated.** (दीप्तिमान)

 
 
• **Example: **The incandescent bulb lit up the entire room.
 
 
 
• **"Incandescent" **refers to something that emits light as a result of being heated. (दीप्तिमान)
 
 
• **Example: **The** incandescent **lamps in the make-up room were very bright.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **with incandescent lights**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **of those subjected to make-up** (मेकअप के अधीन लोगों का): Refers to people who are undergoing the process of make-up.

 
 
• **Example:** The actors were among those subjected to make-up before the shoot.
 
 
 
• **The make-up room was filled** (मेकअप रूम भरा हुआ था): Indicates that the make-up room had many items or people in it.
 
 
• **Example:** The make-up room was filled with artists and their tools.
 
 
 
• **which added to the misery** (जिससे दुःख और बढ़ गया): Refers to something that increased the suffering or discomfort.
 
 
• **Example:** The heat in the room added to the misery of the actors.
 
 

 

46:Tbde,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
